description: Describes an image from an https URL or base64 (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WEBP, up to 4 MB): a short description, visible objects, whether it contains text, and the answer to an optional question. Uses Llama 3.2 11B Vision; the model's answers can be wrong. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: describe_image
title: Describe Image
